g.text: The spool winder's planet in its ring: 18 teeth in 54, module 1
pitch circles (dashed) roll on each other at the pitch point; each flank is the involute of its base circle (dotted), drawn by the end of a string unwound from it
centre distance 18 mm · 0.3333 turns of the second for each turn of the first (18:54), the same way · pressure angle 20°
contact ratio 1.969: the path of contact (5.811 mm, red) over the base pitch (2.952 mm), how many pairs of teeth share the load · backlash 0.15 mm
